title: CT Angiography and Contrast Family Pricing — Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing) Imaging Agreements
content:
**Imaging agreement term.** Riverbend's imaging agreements price the CT angiography (71275 under revenue code 0350, contrast included in its descriptor) and the contrast supply line (Q9967 under revenue code 0636) as one family when an observation or emergency account of the Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) is valued for an Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing):

1. **Commercial PPO Claim that bills the CT angiography:** the family is paid at the CT angiography's counted units times 798.00 USD, the only scan rate covering the contrast, never above the charges of the scan and the contrast together.
2. **Commercial HMO Claim:** the scan is valued at its counted units times 742.00 USD, never above its own charges, and the contrast at its billed units (millilitres) times 0.42 USD, never above its own charges, or at the payer class's expected allowed percentage of its charges when no millilitres are billed.
3. **Otherwise:** the family is valued at the payer class's expected allowed percentage of its charges.

The CT angiography's counted units are its billed units, or one when it is billed with charges but no units.

**Hypothetical cases (scan 2 units charged 3,000.00; contrast 50 millilitres charged 60.00)**
| Payer class | Family value |
|---|---|
| Commercial PPO Claim | 2 times 798.00 → 1,596.00 |
| Commercial HMO Claim | 2 times 742.00 is 1,484.00, plus 50 times 0.42 is 21.00 → 1,505.00 |
| Commercial HMO Claim, contrast charged with no millilitres | 1,484.00 plus the expected allowed percentage of 60.00 |
| Marketplace Exchange Plan Claim | expected allowed percentage of 3,060.00 |
